outcome: Log a received RFP and assign its accountable PM through the live API
acceptance_criteria: Opening Log RFP loads the client list from `GET /received-bids/organisations` and offers exactly those organisations — verify: open `/work`, Start work, Log RFP against the mock on 4981 (and Django 8020); the picker lists the two fixture organisations; network log shows no `GET /lines`.

A valid submit sends one `POST /received-bids` as `multipart/form-data` with `authority`, `start_key`, `reference`, `received_at`, `deadline_status`, `document`, with no `definition`, then one `GET …/receipts/{id}`, and shows "RFP logged." with the reference — verify: network log; test in `useStartWork` or the new `receivedBids` test asserting the form-data keys.
`deadline_at` is sent only when the status is `stated` and is required then — verify: unit test; with "stated" and no date the form shows a field error and sends nothing.

A failed or uncertain POST, then "Check again", sends the same `start_key` and body, and never two different keys for one form — verify: test that fails the first POST with a 503 and compares the two requests.

A file over 5 MiB or not Word/PDF is refused before sending with plain words; a 413 and a 415 from the server show the same words — verify: test with a 6 MiB file and a `.png`; mock fixtures for 413/415.
A duplicate reference shows the API's own `code`/`message` against the Reference field and logs nothing new — verify: mock 409 fixture; the page shows the field message and one POST was made.
The form has no Note field, and the success words name no work item or id — verify: open the drawer; no Note; success shows reference, time, file name.

A person with no organisations sees the empty state and a disabled submit; a 403 shows "You can't log RFPs for this organisation." and nothing else changes (wrong user / wrong tenant) — verify: mock persona with `{items:[]}`, and a 403 fixture.

The Unassigned list reads `GET /received-bids/assignments`, keyed by `case_id`, pages with `cursor`, and shows no Assign button on rows with `owner_access_required: true` — verify: mock list with 13 items over two pages and one restricted row.

The drawer shows nominees, roles and proofs exactly as served, preselects nothing, and requires candidate, role, proof and a non-empty reason before sending — verify: submit empty: summary names all four and no POST is sent; test.

Submit sends one JSON POST `{intake, revision, candidate, role, evidence, reason}` with integer ids taken from the read, and "PM assigned: <name>" appears only after the assignment and list are re-read — verify: network log order POST, GET assignment, GET assignments; test that the success text is absent until the re-reads resolve.

A 5xx or network failure on assign re-reads first and never resends; if `assignment` is now present the drawer shows "Already assigned" — verify: test with a mock that fails the POST but stores the assignment.

A 409 shows "This changed while you were working." and shows the re-read state; a 403 and a 404 show their own plain words; a 422 maps `reason` and `evidence` to their fields — verify: mock fixtures and tests.
`setup_required: true` shows the plain setup message with no form; no nominees shows "No one can be chosen for this RFP yet." — verify: mock fixtures.

The drawer shows no nominee role, no "What happens next" and no "(optional)" on Proof, and the Note is replaced by the required Reason — verify: open the drawer in the mock; file content of `ASSIGN_PM_TEXT` has no `nextHead`/`next`.
A signed-out person on either screen gets the existing signed-out state, not an error — verify: mock 401.

The v7 paths `POST /work`, `POST /work/{id}/assignment` and the base64 `POST /cases/{id}/evidence` are no longer called from these two screens — verify: `grep` in `src/features/start-work` (rfp_intake path) and `src/features/rfp/AssignPmDrawer.tsx`; network log.

Keyboard and accessibility: focus moves to the error callout on failure and to the success message on success; every field has a label — verify: the existing drawer a11y tests extended, and a manual tab through both drawers.

Add tests for each of the above where testable (the five operations in a mocked client, the two drawers with the mock); the existing `AssignForm` callers (other workspace lines) still pass their tests — verify: `delivery/checks.sh` passes and the AssignForm tests are unchanged and green.

risk.rationale: Medium: two cross-layer contract changes (multipart upload, integer ids keyed by `case_id`) and a shared form component (`AssignForm.tsx`) used by other workspace lines. Naming the accountable PM is an identity and responsibility decision, but the backend enforces access and the frontend chooses no one. Product-decision surface: making proof and reason mandatory and dropping the Note change a client-approved flow, so the client must accept the wording. No data migration, payments or security-boundary change on the frontend side.

findings.summary: `withOwnLines` (`src/features/start-work/LineChooser.tsx`) adds "Log a received RFP" for every signed-in person, even when `/lines` does not list it for them. The builder's live run shows this for the seed account. That person reaches the form and gets the organisations 403 or empty state instead of not seeing the line. This is defensible because the organisations read is the real authority check, but note it for the coordinator. The "no lines you can start" empty state in `start-work-live.test.tsx` is now unreachable, and the test was rewritten to match.

`src/features/my-work/MyWork.tsx:70` still declares `notice` and its Callout, but nothing calls `setNotice` with a message now that the assign wiring is gone (only the reset at line 83). Remove it in a later pass. It is harmless.

The Unassigned tab is drawn only when `counts.unassigned` is defined (`MyWork.tsx:286`), and live `/work` returns no `counts`. SCR-24 is therefore reachable only by URL until My work is connected. The builder already reported this and it is outside F-88's lane, so it needs a coordinator decision, not a fix here.

`e2e/rfp-assign.spec.ts` was deleted and no Playwright spec replaces it for the new Unassigned list or the drawer (axe, phone sheet, reduced motion). Vitest covers behaviour. Playwright was not run in this review. The existing `my-work.spec.ts` pm-on-Unassigned case is kept working by the mock's 403 for persona `pm` on `/assignments`.

Start work chooser shows a second "Lines you can start" heading above "Log a received RFP" after the group of F-86 lines, so the heading repeats; the received RFP is also listed separately from its siblings. Expected one list. Actual two same-named groups (`frontend/src/features/start-work/LineChooser.tsx`, `withOwnLines`).

On the mock the Unassigned tab badge and the "6 records you can see" line (from `/work` counts) disagree with the 13 rows the received-bids list serves. Live `/work` has no `counts`, so the tab is hidden there until My work is connected (build.md notes this); worth a follow-up so the number and list come from one source (`frontend/src/features/my-work/MyWork.tsx`).

SCR-24 board draws a blue info callout at the top of the drawer ("Only people allowed to prepare RFPs for this workspace are listed. Who may assign is set by PSL in Setup.") and a helper line under Accountable PM ("3 people can prepare RFPs here"). Neither is built; neither is listed in the spec's accepted changes (only role/hint and "alerted" are). The callout is static copy and the count is `nominees.length`, so "the API has no field" does not apply. Build both, or have the design engineer add them to fidelity-exceptions.json. frontend/src/features/rfp/AssignPmDrawer.tsx.

SCR-24 board keeps "Proof" as a labelled block and an assignment summary; the built drawer has no helper text under "You are assigning as" ("One of the roles PSL allows to assign RFPs"). Role hint is accepted as dropped, but this line is static copy, not served data. Build it or list it as an exception. AssignPmDrawer.tsx.

The RFP reference can't be changed later." is missing; (b) eyebrow reads "START WORK" without "PRE-SALE"; (c) labels renamed: "Client or prospect" -> "Client", "Received" -> "Actually received", "Submit to" -> "Where to submit", "Submission deadline" -> "Deadline"; "Deadline" options "Unknown / Stated / Not stated" -> "Not known / A date is stated / Not stated"; (d) "How the client wants it submitted" is a four-way segmented control on the board (Email, Client portal, By hand, Not stated) and a select ("Submission method", "Choose...") in the build; (e) the board's hint lines under RFP reference ("As written on their document"), Received ("When it actually arrived, not when you log it") and Submit to are missing. The client-name pair is accepted by LC-Q8; the rest are not. Restore the board wording, control and hints, or get them approved as exceptions. frontend/src/features/start-work/lines/receivedBid.tsx.
